title: Cilengitide limits syndromic and sporadic thoracic aortic aneurysm by targeting specific αV integrin.
snippet: Thoracic aortic aneurysm (TAA) is one of the major causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide, still lacking an etiologic therapy. Aberrant activation of TGF-β and dysregulation of mechanotransduction signalling in vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) play a key role in the pathology.
